newsitem.title: USA: SBC says Fed approves Dillon Read merger.
newsitem.headline: SBC says Fed approves Dillon Read merger.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp said on Tuesday that the U.S. Federal Reserve Board has approved its application to acquire Dillon, Read & Co Inc.
Swiss Bank said in a statement the merged operation of Dillon Read and its SBC Warburg unit is set for September 2.
In May, Swiss Bank announced its plan to acquire the U.S. investment bank for $600 million. After the merger it will be known as SBC Warburg Dillon Read.
Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV owns 25 percent of Dillon Read and Dillon Read's partners own the balance of the firm.
